text:
marta: Heads-up: canary showing unexpected semantic drift on 2 small traffic slices. Thinking through rollback criteria + cutover plan. cc @sam @priya

deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3.5.1 -> 12% traffic (us-west-2). Metrics: p95 latency +38% vs baseline, error-rate +0.6pp, eval perplexity delta +1.2. Auto-rollback flags: false (error-rate threshold 1.5pp).

sam: I see a correlated spike in backend failures tied to kv-cache mismatches in the logs. Sample log: `kvcache miss: expected key len 64 got 63`

priya: Are these customer-facing (5xx) or internal retries? Need clarity before we call a manual hold.

deploy-bot: traffic-slice-7: p50 degraded, p95 +34%. 5xx rate still low but instrumented evals showing regression on prompt set A. No auto-rollback triggered.

chris: Infra note: we can pin slice routing back to v3.4.9 quickly. Manual rollback (partial slice) estimated ~6-10m including conn drain. Recommend targeted 50% revert for slice 7 first.

jonathan: Proposed decision rule: trigger manual rollback if either (a) sustained 5xx >0.5% for 5min OR (b) eval regression >1.0 and any customer error reports. Otherwise keep paused and gather traces for 10m.

marta: Plan: 10m observation window starting now. If 5xx >0.3% AND p95 latency >+30% -> execute manual rollback on affected slices. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb if we need it.

sam: I'll prep the rollback-runbook ticket and the pin command. Pin command ready: `infra ctl route set --model v3.4.9 --slice 7 --percent 100` (will run only if criteria met).

priya: Also going to test cache toggle hypothesis on slice 7: set env `REDWOOD_DISABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=1` in canary to see if kv misses stop.

deploy-bot: Manual hold requested by @marta. Rollout paused at 12%. Canary timers frozen.

marta: Action items: @sam on pin/rollback if criteria hit, @priya toggle cache and share traces, @chris be ready for cutover/infra ops, @jonathan run eval regressions check every 2m. I'll notify support to watch customer channels.

priya: Quick Q — do we notify customers proactively now or wait until rollback? Leaning to wait unless we confirm >0.5% 5xx or support sees reports.

sam: Agreed, hold comms unless we trigger. I'll post to #incidents if we execute rollback. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks all — I'll check back in T+6m. If nothing escalates we'll either unpause or move to a partial rollback per chris' suggestion.
